marks.gloss_en: כי ההוא דמקרי דרדקי ... ואהדריה רבינא -- an incident adduced for the mitzva limit (no support kind for a maaseh, so svara)
Ameimar: the halakha -- even for the one who says a vow made in public has release, [a vow made] on the mind of the many has no release

the mishna: there is a firstborn for inheritance and not for the priest; for the priest and not for inheritance; for inheritance and for the priest; and one who is a firstborn neither for inheritance nor for the priest
R' Meir: which is a firstborn for inheritance and not for the priest? one who comes after nefalim, even though [the nefel] put out its head alive
the Sages: [the one after it is not a firstborn for the priest] only if [the miscarriage] has something of the form of a person
the mishna: one who had no sons and married a woman who had already given birth -- [her son by him] is a firstborn for inheritance and not for the priest
R' Yosei HaGelili: [the son of one who gave birth while a maidservant] is a firstborn for inheritance AND for the priest
שנאמר: פטר רחם בישראל -- עד שיפטרו רחם מישראל (restated at 47a.10 and 47a.11)
the mishna: one who had sons and married a woman who had not given birth -- [her son] is a firstborn for the priest and not for inheritance (the ruling closes 46a.11)
the mishna: she gave birth together with a priest's [daughter/wife] -- [the son] is a firstborn for the priest and not for inheritance
there [the one who married in transgression] -- his inclination seizes him
